- Test findExactMatch returns copy; modifications to returned set don't affect zone.

SetResponse methods: getCNAME returns CNAMERecord. If we used generic Record, maybe not. Safer to use actual CNAMERecord class, but not listed. @Test public void testZoneConstructionAndBasicAccess() throws Exception { create records, new Zone(origin, records...), assertNotNull getSOA, getNS size >0 }

Test addRecord adding extra A record to same name, ensure findExactMatch includes it.

Test removeRecord removing A record, ensure removed.

Test removeRecord cannot remove SOA (expect IllegalArgumentException).

Test removeRecord cannot remove last NS (expect IllegalArgumentException).

Test addRRset replacement: create new RRset with A record, addRRset, ensure findExactMatch returns new set.

Test removeRRset removal.

Test findRecords delegation: create child name "sub.example.com." with NS record, query that name for A type expecting delegation (SetResponse.isDelegation true).

Test findRecords CNAME: create CNAME for "cname.example.com." pointing to "target.example.com.", query CNAME name for A type expecting CNAME response.

Test findRecords DNAME: create DNAME for "dname.example.com.", query "foo.dname.example.com." expecting DNAME.

Test wildcard: add wildcard *.example.com. with A record, query "foo.example.com." expecting successful with expanded A.

Test ANY: query origin with Type.ANY expecting SetResponse with multiple RRsets.

Test iterator order: ensure first two are SOA and NS.

Test AXFR iterator includes SOA at end.

Test toMasterFile contains expected string representation of records.

Edge cases: invalid arguments: constructing Zone with null name throws IllegalArgumentException; addRecord null throws; addRRset null; removeRRset invalid type (Type.SOA) expecting IllegalArgumentException (InvalidTypeException? Actually removeRRset checks Type.check then removeRRsetWithoutLock will throw IllegalArgumentException for SOA). So we can test that.

We'll need to catch exceptions.
